grown up, full-grown, Hariv.; Kāv.; Rājat.

married, W.
luxuriant (as a plant), Bhartṛ.; Kāvyād.
large, great, mighty, strong, Kāv.; Kathās.; Pañcat.
violent, impetuous (as love), Prab.; Rājat.
thick, dense (as darkness), Mālatīm.
full (as the moon), W.
(ifc.) filled with, full of (see मृदु-प्र्˚)
proud, arrogant, confident, bold, audacious, impudent (esp. said of a woman), Kāv.; BhP.
controverted, W.

(with Śāktas) N. of one of the 7 Ullāsas

a married woman from 30 to 55 years of age, W.
a violent or impetuous woman (described as a Nāyikā who stands in no awe of her lover or husband), W.

1. प्रौह m. = 1. प्रोह, L.
2. प्रौह mfn. and m. id., L.
1. 2. प्रौह See col. 2.
mf(ई)n. having the sense of ‘तेन-प्रोक्तम्’, proclaimed by that (said of a suffix), Pāṇ. iv, 3, 101.
w.r. for प्रउग, MānGṛŚrS.
Nom. ˚यति = प्र्ऽओघीय, Vop.
प्रौढ—चरित-नामन् n. pl. N. of wk. by Vallabhācārya on the titles of Kṛṣṇa derived from 128 of his exploits during adolescence.
प्रौढ—जलद m. a dense cloud, Bhartṛ.
प्रौढ—तात्पर्य-संग्रह m. N. of wk.
प्रौढ—त्व n. confidence, arrogance, Kathās.
प्रौढ—दोर्-दण्ड m. a strong and long arm, Prab.
प्रौढ—पाद mfn. one whose feet are raised (on a bench or in some partic. position), Mn.; Gaut.; Hcat.
प्रौढ—पुष्प mfn. having blossoms full-grown (as a tree), Megh.
प्रौढ—प्रकाशिका f. N. of a Comm. on Prab.
प्रौढ—प्रताप mfn. of mighty prowess, renowned in arms, MW.
प्रौढ—प्रताप—मार्तण्ड m. N. of wk. on the appropriate seasons for the worship of Viṣṇu,
प्रौढ—प्रिया f. a bold or confident mistress, Ragh.
प्रौढ—मनोरमा f. N. of a Comm. on Siddh. and other works.
प्रौढ-मनोरमा—कुच-मर्दन n. N. of wk.
प्रौढ-मनोरमा—खण्डन n. N. of wk.
प्रौढ—यौवन mfn. being in the prime or bloom of youth (अति- and अन्-अति-प्र्˚), Megh.; Hit.
प्रौढ—वत्सा f. having a full-grown calf, L.
प्रौढ—वाद m. a bold or arrogant assertion, Hcar.
प्रौढ—व्यञ्जक m. N. of wk.
प्रौढ—स्वरम् ind. with a strong or loud voice, Pañcad.
impetuously or furiously dragged along, Śak. i, 32 (v.l. for पादाकृ˚).
a bold woman, Bhartṛ.
pl. bold or confident behaviour, Kathās.
one of the 7 Ullāsas.
a bold expression or speech, Kuval.
full growth, increase, Kathās.
full development, maturity, perfection, high degree, ib.; BhP.
greatness, dignity, Vcar.
self-confidence, boldness, assurance, Kāv.; Kathās.
zeal, exertion, W.
controversy, discussion, ib.
प्रौढि—वाद m. a bold assertion, pompous speech, L. (cf. प्रौढ-व्˚).
the state of full growth, Vām. v, 2, 56.
प्रौढी-√ भू P. -भवति, to grow up, increase, come to maturity, Ragh.; Rājat.
clever, learned, skilful, L. (cf. 2. प्रौह, प्रोह).
